Subject: Markov chains | ID: 32771

Step 3. By the stationary spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01270013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the stationary spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through Fourier approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
